evals.prompt: 我的 Syncthing 显示有意外项目，帮我清理一下
evals.expected_output: The skill should locate Syncthing configuration, identify unexpected items in sync folders, and provide cleanup instructions or run the cleanup script
assertions: The skill identifies the Syncthing configuration location
The skill explains what types of items will be cleaned (conflicts, empty dirs, temp files, symlinks)
The skill offers to run the cleanup script or provides manual cleanup steps

evals.prompt: Clean up Syncthing conflict files in my ~/Develop folder
evals.expected_output: The skill should run cleanup targeting conflict files in the specified folder
assertions: The skill runs the cleanup script with --folders ~/Develop --types conflicts
The skill explains what the script is doing
The skill reports the results of the cleanup

evals.prompt: I want to see what files would be deleted before cleaning
evals.expected_output: The skill should run cleanup in dry-run mode to show what would be deleted without actually deleting
assertions: The skill shows a preview of items that would be deleted
The skill explains that no files were actually deleted
